mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.git_url, p.git_branch, p.git_commit, p.credential_enc, p.credential_user, p.status, p.last_error, p.last_indexed_at, p.last_index_ms, round(extract(epoch from (now() - p.updated_at)) * 1000) AS elapsed_ms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_document d WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS chunk_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND c.chunk_type != 'FILE') AS symbol_chunk_count, p.index_total_files, p.index_processed_files, p.index_skipped_files, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM ai_code_project p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.git_url, p.git_branch, p.git_commit, p.credential_enc, p.credential_user, p.status, p.last_error, p.last_indexed_at, p.last_index_ms, round(extract(epoch from (now() - p.updated_at)) * 1000) AS elapsed_ms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_document d WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS chunk_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND c.chunk_type != 'FILE') AS symbol_chunk_count, p.index_total_files, p.index_processed_files, p.index_skipped_files, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM ai_code_project p WHERE p.created_by = #{userId}
mapper.select: ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_project WHERE created_by = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_code_project (id, name, git_url, git_branch, credential_enc, credential_user, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{gitUrl}, #{gitBranch}, #{credentialEnc}, #{credentialUser}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_code_project SET status = 'INDEXING', last_error = NULL, index_total_files = #{totalFiles}, index_processed_files = 0, index_skipped_files = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_code_project SET index_processed_files = #{processedFiles}, index_skipped_files = #{skippedFiles}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_code_project SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_code_project SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'INDEXING') AND updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{graceSeconds} * interval '1 second')
